_schema.note: Locations with their historical versions and map potential. 'map_ids' lists implemented maps.

entries.name: Fort Feather
entries.description: Military base built by Parrot east of the kingdom to train soldiers and defend against Cindercrest. First battle of the Civil War: Cindercrest failed by ground assault, then landed slow-falling paratroopers from a Redstone Blimp. The Fort Feather legion retreated to Merchant City through an underground tunnel; Parrot partially self-destructed the fort with TNT.
entries.map_potential: VERTICAL SLICE MAP: hold the fort against Cindercrest waves, blimp paratrooper event, Saparata boss.

entries.name: Spawn
entries.description: Torn down by the Invisible Mafia for a giant prison forcing new players to join (designed by _Kenadian_). Overrun with withers at one point (Theo saved Parrot from two withers there). In Season 3 spawn had a blue castle and village under Parrot's Kingdom; Saparata captured it and killed new players on sight.
entries.map_potential: Several variants: prison break (Mafia), wither siege, new-player massacre defence (Cindercrest).

entries.name: Capital City / Capitol City
entries.description: Desert-empire themed city near spawn with a Main Building over 100 blocks tall; safe space for all players. Site of the Battle for Capital City: evacuation, Wemmbu's orbital nuke shot, Cindercrest and Cave Kingdom armies pouring through the Main Building ruins, the Royal Army's defection and the Saparata–Parrot duel.
entries.map_potential: Campaign finale map: defend the Main Building; orbital strike hazards.

entries.name: Merchant City
entries.description: Eastern gateway of Parrot's Kingdom. DanchoGold tried to imprison Parrot's group over Theo's debt; taken hostage, his guard force sided with Parrot. Second major battle of the Civil War; ShoeBilly maced defenders until Cindercrest was forced to retreat.
entries.map_potential: Second campaign map: protect the markets; ShoeBilly assassin waves.

entries.name: Highwater City
entries.description: Major city of Parrot's Kingdom; one of the Civil War battlegrounds.

entries.name: Steampunk City
entries.description: City led by mayor 4CVIT. Wemmbu was sent there by Arachnid to defeat Cindercrest's representative; his stab shots destroyed parts of the city while fighting ShoeBilly.

entries.name: Northern Council
entries.description: One of the largest builds by the Law; de-facto capital of the SMP where the King lives and governs.

entries.name: LAW Headquarters / LAW City
entries.description: Rebuilt by SargeLAW from Law stashes after its destruction; south of the kingdom. Related outposts: Smuggler's Pass Outpost (fort and prison) and LAW Desert Outpost.

entries.name: Ironclad City
entries.description: Northern border city of Parrot's Kingdom.

entries.name: Newtopia
entries.description: Western border city of Parrot's Kingdom.

entries.name: Kingdom of the Caves
entries.description: Arachn1d's underground kingdom with mines (wardens), stasis chambers holding Eggchan, and the pit where Wemmbu was betrayed.
entries.map_potential: Cave map with warden hazards and web traps; Arachn1d boss.

entries.name: Skymore
entries.description: Parrot's failed safe haven for 1,000 new players, far from spawn; massacred by ShoeBilly and Cindercrest.

entries.name: Far Lands
entries.description: Remote region hosting the Far Lands Civilization resistance cell; the only place where ominous spawners (maces) survived the Mafia.
entries.map_potential: Last-stand map versus the Invisible Mafia.

entries.name: The End
entries.description: Parrot created The End Civilization; Spoke's End base was destroyed by Wemmbu and Eggchan.

entries.name: The Nether
entries.description: Ruled by ClownPierce; site of the Orbital Strike Cannon control room.

entries.name: Cindercrest Outpost
entries.description: One of the Civil War battle sites; Cindercrest also holds strongholds in its territory (one was captured by the NULL).

entries.name: Purgatory
entries.description: Prison at the centre of Spoke's Purgatory Arc.

entries.name: Redstone Town
entries.description: 4CVIT's outpost dedicated to redstone.

entries.name: Lomedy's Farm
entries.description: Where Flame and Lomedy met and defended against the toxic civilization.

entries.name: Paragon
entries.description: Place Parrot escaped from at the start of the Treasure Arc; nature not recovered.
